referenceSources.title: A vendre 306 Maxi V1 - Voitures de course • GoToTheGrid  🏁
referenceSources.description:
A striking yellow Peugeot 306 Maxi V1 is captured mid-stage on a winding, forest-lined tarmac road. The car’s livery features bold Motul branding on the hood and front bumper, alongside Garage Jenatton and VRAT logos. The number 29 is displayed on the windshield, indicating its competition entry.

Under the hood, this V1 chassis houses an EV7 engine upgraded with an EV9 crankshaft, delivering 291 hp at 9800 rpm. It’s paired with a revised X-TRAC 6-speed gearbox, V1 front suspension with V2 dampers, and V2 rear suspension. High-performance braking is provided by 355 mm Brembo 8-piston front calipers and 260 mm Alcon Peugeot Sport rear calipers. This rally-prepared machine is listed for sale in France, with price available on request.
